name: create_character
description: Create a new character entry in the knowledge base. This will fail if a character with this name already exists in this canon - use update_character instead to modify existing entries. Always use search_characters first to avoid creating duplicates.

canon.description: Canon this character belongs to (e.g., 'main', 'film', 'legends'). Use the canon determined by determine_canon().

aliases.description: Optional list of alternate names or titles (e.g., ['Avatar Aang', 'The Last Airbender'])

bio.description: Optional brief biography or description of the character

source_url.description: URL of the wiki page where this character was discovered
